task_completion.description: Agent successfully logged into the SuiteCRM admin dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SuiteCRM dashboard or the 'Admin' menu options rather than the login screen.

task_completion.description: Agent navigated to the 'System Settings' configuration page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The page header or breadcrumbs indicate 'System Settings' and the configuration form is visible.

task_completion.description: The 'System Name' field is updated to 'Meridian Wholesale CRM'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text input field labeled 'System Name' contains the string 'Meridian Wholesale CRM'.

task_completion.description: The 'Listview items per page' is set to 50.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The input field for 'Listview items per page' (under the 'User Interface' section) shows the value '50'.

task_completion.description: The option to prevent user customizable layouts is enabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The checkbox for 'Prevent user customizable Homepage layout' (or 'Lock homepage layout') is checked.

task_completion.description: The company logo from the specified path is uploaded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file picker shows '/home/ga/Documents/meridian_logo.png' being selected or the 'Current Logo' preview updates after saving.

task_completion.description: The agent clicked the 'Save' button to apply all changes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the 'Save' button, and a success message or a return to the Admin panel is visible.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than modifying config files via the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show mouse movements and clicks within the browser on the System Settings page, not commands in a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the file system to upload the specific logo file.
integrity.visual_evidence: A file upload dialog or the path '/home/ga/Documents/meridian_logo.png' is visible during the upload process.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the UI menus rather than jumping directly to internal PHP save scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking 'Admin' then 'System Settings' in the navigation sequence.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required System Name is 'Meridian Wholesale CRM'. The Listview items per page must be exactly 50. The 'Prevent user customizable Homepage layout' checkbox must be checked. The logo file is located at '/home/ga/Documents/meridian_logo.png'. All changes must be saved via the 'Save' button on the System Settings page.
